maseffects.config.title: Mas Effects
maseffects.tooltips.maceshowckwave: If enabled, creates a shockwave effect when slamming with the mace
maseffects.tooltips.maceshockwavesize: Increases the size of the mace shockwave
maseffects.tooltips.maceshockwaveopacity: Sets the opacity of the mace shockwave
maseffects.tooltips.macespark: Creates spark particles when slamming with the mace
maseffects.tooltips.maceflash: Creates flash upon slamming with the mace
maseffects.tooltips.shieldeffect: Creates a small shockwave on a player´s shield when blocking mace attacks
maseffects.tooltips.armorparticles: If enabled spawns armor breaking particles when using the breach enchantment
maseffects.tooltips.customtotemeffect: If enabled changes the totem particle effect completely
maseffects.tooltips.totemeffectopacity: Changes the opacity of the totem effect
maseffects.tooltips.playerdeatheffect: Spawns custom death particles when a player dies
maseffects.tooltips.pearltrailparticles: Makes ender pearls spawn a trail of particles
maseffects.tooltips.pearltrailopacity: Sets the opacity of the ender pearl trail particles
maseffects.tooltips.customhitbox: Enhances the player and pearl hitboxes when pressing F3+B
maseffects.tooltips.pearlhitboxcolors: Change the ender pearl hitbox color depending on who threw it
maseffects.tooltips.pearlwhitelist: Players in this list will be considered allies for the following values
maseffects.tooltips.selfpearlcolor: Color of ender pearl hitboxes thrown by you
maseffects.tooltips.allypearlcolor: Color of ender pearl hitboxes thrown by your allies
maseffects.tooltips.otherpearlcolor: Color of ender pearl hitboxes thrown by other players
maseffects.tooltips.hitboxfadedistance: Distance in blocks where the hitbox starts to fade for mobs and players
maseffects.tooltips.hitboxprojectilefade: Distance in blocks where the hitbox starts to appear for pearls and wind charges
maseffects.tooltips.legacyshockwave: Removes the spikes on the shockwave
